questions.question:
**In the given sentence, identify the segment which contains a grammatical error.**

People has been warning in advance about the coming economic crisis.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'has been warning'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to **the subject-verb agreement rule**, if the subject is singular, the verb must be singular and if the subject is plural, the verb must also be plural. 
 
• **Examples, **
 
 
• These **clothes are** too small for me.
 
• **People travel **overseas these days.
 
• Some **people were** hurt.
 
 
 
• The word '**people**' is a** plural noun.** So, it should be followed by a **plural verb. (have)**
 
• Thus, 'have been warned' is the correct usage.
 
• We need to use a verb warned because the doer of the verb warned is somebody else hence we need to use a past participle of the verb. As the warning has been given to the people by somebody else. Hence, the correct phrase is have been warned.
 
• Therefore, **option 4** is the correct answer.

**Correct Sentence:** *People **have been warned** in advance about the coming economic crisis.*

• Khwaja Moinuddin Chisti also popularly known as Khwaja Gareeb Nawaz was a beloved Sufi saint of the Chisti order.
 
• He is known to be the direct descendant of Prophet Muhammad.
 
• Born in Sistan (present-day Eastern Iran and Southern Afghanistan, he travelled from Sistan to Lahore to Delhi, and finally settled in Ajmer, Rajasthan.
 
• His tomb in Ajmer, the Ajmer Sharif Dargah, is one of the holiest Islamic sites in the world.
 
• Muslims from across the world visit Dargah Sharif every year to offer their prayers.
 
• Not only Muslims but people belonging to different religions visit this shrine throughout the year.
 
 
 
• Baba Farid
 
 
• Baba Sheikh Farid as he is called all over Punjab, India, and Pakistan was born at the time when Punjab was going through great crossroads.
 
• Timur the Lame, Halaku (Son of Changez Khan), etc ravaged Punjab about 100 to 200 years before he was born.
 
• The Slave dynasty of Qutub-Ud-Din aibak was at that time being ruled by Sultan Balban. 200-300 years earlier to the West of India, the sword of Islam had swept in the countries like Iran, Afghanistan, and Eastern Europe.
 
• In India too, Slave Qutubdin Aibak tried to subdue people through force, but could only create a rift between different communities.
 
• Then came the Sufi saints from Arabia and other places to spread their message of love for Allah.
 
• Sufi saints like Khwaja Qutub-Ul-Din Bakhtiar Kaki, who was a Sayid of the Jafiri Hussaini tribe, were very famous.
 
 
 
• Qutubuddin Bakhtiyar Kaki
 
 
• Hazrat Khawaja Bakhtiyar Kaaki‎ was one and a half years old when his father passed away.
 
• Khawaja Qutubuddeen Bakhtiyar Kaaki‎ learned 15 chapters of the Holy Quran from his mother and his mother arranged for his further education and training.

questions.question: Which part of the human body has the growth stages divided into - Anagen, Catagen and Telogen?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Hair__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The human body's hair follicles comprise three distinctive phases: **anagen, catagen, and telogen phase**.
 
• **Anagen** is the growth phase and approximately 85% of all hairs are in a growing phase at any one time.
 
• **Melanin** is made in the hair bulb throughout this phase. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__**
 
• The** catagen** phase follows the anagen stage it is a **1- to 2-week transition stage between anagen and telogen**.
 
• **The telogen phase **is referred to as the resting phase which typically lasts for 3 months.

questions.question: LCD is a basic type of monitor. What is the full form of LCD?

__
 
• LCD is a flat panel display system that is primarily seen in Computer screens, Televisions, and Cell Phones.
 
• It utilizes liquid crystals as its primary mode of operation instead of cathode rays.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Construction of LCD​

 
• It is comprised of two phases; the liquid and the solid matter with additional two layers comprised of two polarized filters & electrodes.
 
• This screen works by blocking the light beam also the solid element is the crystal and the combination of solid and liquid makes the image clear.

Advantages of LCD

 
• It has low cost and energy consumption with high energy efficiency.
 
• It is smaller, thinner, and is very flexible.
 
• It offers excellent contrast, brightness & resolution, so the accuracy of the image is as evident as crystal.
